# An interpreter of the StrongARM's instruction set (ARMCPU.h): ARMv4, ARM
# state, over a memory the caller supplies.  No Newton dependencies.
add_library(armcpu STATIC
    ARMCPU.cpp
)
target_include_directories(armcpu PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

# The adapter that runs packages' native functions on it
# (PackageNativeCPU.h): the fallback of frames/PackageNatives.h, the ROM's
# public jump table (PublicJumpTable.cpp, generated by
# tools/newton-rom/analysis/gluetable.py) answered on the host.
add_library(armcpu_frames STATIC
    PackageNativeCPU.cpp
    PublicJumpTable.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(armcpu_frames PUBLIC newton_config armcpu frames)
target_include_directories(armcpu_frames PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

add_subdirectory(tests)
